subtasks: S1 action-protocol: ActionCapability.PUBLISH + publish payload + key-level three-state serializer + not-wired 501
S2 policy-engine: deterministic fail-closed verdict between plan_action and resolve_action
S3 action-executor: PUBLISH via Tool Gateway, idempotency key wired, RetryPolicy unlocked
S4 mainline: PublisherAgent emits PublishIntent, xhs.publish orphan disappears, gate assertion updated in same PR
notes: S2 landed on feat/p2a-s2-policy-engine (base 2481e991). Scope: a deterministic publish policy gate evaluated inside plan_action, after shape validation and before create_action, so a denial leaves no Action Intent behind. New module backend/creator_agent/policy.py (pure rule table + one injectable seam to xhs_risk_gate); denial -> ActionPolicyDeniedError -> HTTP 403 ERROR_CREATOR_ACTION_POLICY_DENIED carrying policy_id/account_id/retry_after_seconds. Gates: pytest 3115 passed/3 skipped (S1 3095 + 20 = zero existing cases touched), ruff 497 files, mypy 201 files clean, P1b baseline drift within threshold, tool_runtime_gate OK (xhs.publish still the only orphan by design until S4). Mutation self-check 6/6 killed, each by a named assertion, one per mechanism. Two findings: (a) the fail-closed guarantee had to move from the default checker into the seam -- a test injecting a raising checker proved the first version was fail-open for any other checker; (b) PRE-EXISTING DEFECT, pinned not fixed: the account-keyed publish cooldown has no production writer (services/xhs_publisher records only cdp_endpoint), so check_publish_allowed(account_id=...) returns None for every account in production and the RISK_COOLDOWN rule is wired + tested but currently unreachable. Pinned by test_the_intent_time_check_reads_a_key_the_runtime_never_writes; S3 must record the account key when it executes a publish. Decision on open question 2: denials are NOT persisted -- a permanently unconfirmable intent is a dead record; visibility comes from the 403 body plus an advisor warning log, and a persisted denial audit is deferred to S5.
